## code-style

A Quarto reveal.js extension for **named visual treatments** on regions of
code blocks. The `diff` preset ships out of the box; see
[`examples/diff.qmd`](examples/diff.html).

## Quick taste

```{.r data-code-style="add:2-3, rem:5"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```
